title: Kata Module content pack
description: docs/engineering.md § 3 Content schema — the machine-checkable twin of the ModuleContent TypeScript type (§ 2). One file per non-pending Module at public/content/modules/<id>.json, validated by scripts/validate-content.mjs before every deploy. The ≤ 40-line rule on Model Example C# sides is an authoring rule checked in review, not here.

id.description: Matches the file name and an index entry: 'm01' … 'm05', 'ai01' … 'ai06'.

modelExamples.description: 2–3 before/after C# pairs with a caption for what moved or got hidden.

exercises.description: 0..n Exercise briefs; [] is valid and means the Module only explains. How many a Module carries is an authoring convention (docs/design.md § Module anatomy: a Software Design Module ships one refactor and one construct), not a schema rule.

selfCheckQuestions.description: Exactly 3 Self-Check questions, each a set of 2–4 radio options.

id.description: Unique app-wide, equal to its repo folder name: the Module id, a dash, 'e', an ordinal — 'm01-e1', 'ai03-e1'.

smell.description: The planted flaw — Exercise Spec row 2.

targetInterfaceCode.description: The boundary the learner must end up behind, written in the Category’s practice language; rendered read-only.

folderUrl.description: GitHub folder URL, or null until the Exercise folder is committed.

prompt.description: Behaviorally answerable — countable or doable (docs/design.md § Pedagogy).

explanation.description: Optional teaching line, revealed once the reader picks any option and identical whichever one was picked — never a right/wrong marking. 1–3 sentences in the novice voice (docs/design.md § Editorial standard).

options.description: 2–4 radio options; their values are unique within the question (checked by scripts/validate-content.mjs).
